notes.title: Unlocked Sensitivity Patch
notes.content: FPS Unlocked mode allows sensitivity to 99

notes.title: FPS unlock fix
notes.content: Fixed bug where the unlocked FPS launch option wasn't loading levels

notes.title: FPS Patch
notes.content: Added launch option for unlocked framerate version of the game

notes.title: Another patch
notes.content:
Fix SFX volume not changing all volume on all sounds
Fixed leaderboards alignment on HD and Classic

notes.title: Level 10 fix
notes.content: Fixed soft lock on level 10 on classic mode

notes.title: Another patch for classic
notes.content:
Improved draw distance for sprites, less pop-in
Health pickup now worth 25 rather than 20 health points
Adjusted health on enemies to closer match the HD version.

notes.title: First classic patch
notes.content:
Visibility improved
Enemy fire removes less health
Enemies require less damage

notes.title: Another weapon patch
notes.content:
Improve shotgun balancing (Double barrel was UP and Shotgun pistol was OP)
Fixed bug where Shotgun pistol shots weren't spreading
The look axis can now be inverted by adding the Launch Option -invertY

notes.title: Weapon update
notes.content:
Auto-Shotgun replaced with shotgun pistol
Design updates to double-barrel shotgun and pistol to make more consistant
Additional control for cursor player
Slight weapon balancing

notes.title: Sensitivity and more update
notes.content:
Added sensitivity option
Fixed bug with player getting stuck teleporting
Fixed lose focus on pause
Fixed not being able to refocus
Fixed shotgun rounds showing -1 rounds
fixed "Brand New Glow Up" Achievement
Grenades key now added to Right Ctrl (STRG)

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content:
Fixed incorrect window name
Fixed Death Rush achievement not firing
